sheetControl.description: Auction describes three 11-by-11 Revised sheets. No sufficiently detailed source images acquired for calibration.
sheetControl.method: Estimate sheet-wide perspective/distortion from the repeated grid, then measure printed art/paper edges at every cell. Compare offsets by sheet position, repeated printing and design origin. Use multiple sheets/captures to separate sheet variation from capture distortion; do not infer cutting offsets from uncut paper or generalize one sheet to every print run.
